title: Build continuous data and AI pipelines with BigQuery continuous queries
description: Learn about real-time AI-powered insights with BigQuery continuous queries, and how this new feature is poised to revolutionize data engineering by empowering event-driven and AI-driven data pipelines with Vertex AI, Pub/Sub, and Bigtable - all through the familiar language of Cloud SQL. Learn about how UPS was able to use big data on millions of shipped packages to reduce package theft, their work on more efficient claims processing, and why they are looking to BigQuery to accelerate time to insights and smarter business outcomes.
